senses.gloss: to be bent, doubled; to be wearied.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:3">Ḥull. II, 3</cite> <he>ועָף</he>, v. <cite ref="U00632"><he>שָׁחַז</he></cite>. Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII, beg. <he>מריב עונית … עָפִים ומתעלפים</he> on account of the multitude of my sins are the righteous in me wearied and faint.—Denom. <cite ref="P00315"><he>עוֹף</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00635"><he>עָיֵף</he></cite>.
